photos.desc: Submerged Sharp-leaved Pondweed ( Potamogeton acutifolius ) in a natural habitat, a weedy pond. View ~vertically from above through the surface of the water, which was about 40 cm deep at this point.
Detail of the Sharp-leaved Pondweed ( Potamogeton acutifolius ).
Close-up of leaves of the Sharp-leaved Pondweed ( Potamogeton acutifolius ). The leaves have a width of about 3–3.5 mm. (Magnification ratio of the 1:1 macro lens has been doubled by a 2×TC.)
